newsitem.title: FINLAND: KEMIRA TO START SODIUM PERCARBONATE OUTPUT.
newsitem.headline: KEMIRA TO START SODIUM PERCARBONATE OUTPUT.

text.p: Finnish chemicals and fertiliser group Kemira Oy said in a statement on Monday its industrial chemicals unit will start producing sodium percarbonate at the end of 1997 in Helsingborg, Sweden.
"The capacity of the plant will be 20,000 tonnes per year," Kemira said.
It did not give details on the investment in the new production line.
Sodium percarbonate, or sodium carbonate peroxyhydrate, is an environmentally friendly bleaching and disinfection chemical particularly used in detergents, Kemira said.
"The new product will complement the range of chemicals supplied to detergent manufacturers, and is also a natural extension of Kemira Chemicals' investment in bleaching technology," it said.
